name: Noor
title: Noor — Satin stiletto
short: Ivory satin-look folds, a fine ankle strap and a delicate pointed silhouette.
description: Noor is a study in quiet drama: a luminous pointed toe, a fine ankle strap and a clean, slender heel. A design direction for modern occasionwear.

name: Sable
title: Sable — Patent slingback
short: A sharp black slingback with a whisper of gold.
description: Sable pairs a precise pointed toe with a glossy charcoal finish and an understated gold-tone buckle. A confident finishing note for tailoring or eveningwear.

name: Mehfil
title: Mehfil — Crystal evening sandal
short: Champagne latticework with a little evening light.
description: Mehfil explores fine crystal-like lattice straps and a champagne finish. An evening silhouette conceived for celebration and modern Pakistani occasionwear.

name: Sitara
title: Sitara — Pearl-detail sandal
short: Ivory straps, pearl-like accents, a softer sculptural heel.
description: Sitara brings a restrained pearl-like flourish to slim ivory straps and a balanced, sculptural heel. A quieter interpretation of occasion dressing.

name: Gul
title: Gul — Zari-inspired khussa
short: Botanical gold embroidery in a traditional pointed form.
description: Gul reinterprets the Pakistani khussa with botanical zari-inspired embroidery, antique-gold tones and an expressive pointed toe. Tradition, seen through an EDNA lens.

name: Raqs
title: Raqs — Mirrorwork khussa
short: Deep olive and tiny mirrored geometry.
description: Raqs contrasts deep olive with miniature mirrorwork-inspired details and geometric embroidery. A traditional flat with a contemporary, independent point of view.

name: Forma
title: Forma — Sculptural mule
short: Folded stone-toned straps and an architectural heel.
description: Forma makes a statement through proportion: a softly squared toe, a folded upper and a curved heel with a gold-tone accent. An exercise in everyday sculpture.

name: Lina
title: Lina — Cap-toe ballet flat
short: Sand, charcoal and the smallest bow.
description: Lina combines a sand-toned upper with a charcoal cap toe and a tiny bow. A considered everyday flat with a clean, easy-to-style profile.

name: Cypher
title: Cypher — Sculpted sneaker
short: Ivory, olive and a flash of lime.
description: Cypher brings EDNA into the street: layered ivory and olive panels, a sculpted sole and a small lime accent. A confident sneaker concept for unexpected pairings.

name: Reverb
title: Reverb — Utility high-top
description: Reverb pushes volume with a substantial high-top shape, charcoal and silver-tone panels and a wide ankle strap. A bold design direction rooted in street style.

name: Orbit
title: Orbit — Chrome sculptural heel
short: Reflective silver, a sculptural oval, a different point of view.
description: Orbit turns the heel into an object of fascination. Reflective silver-tone straps meet an open oval heel in a sculptural evening concept made to start a conversation.

name: Fable
title: Fable — Feather platform
short: Deep oxblood, a dramatic platform and a feather-like flourish.
description: Fable is EDNA at its most expressive: a deep oxblood platform, a bold block heel and a theatrical feather-like toe detail. A statement concept for after-dark dressing.
